title: Explicit probes for host and network access
expected: Build actions and hooks cannot read an undeclared host sentinel or access an unapproved loopback service.
Development execution is not evidence of sandbox enforcement.

cases.name: host-file
cases.change: Supply a temporary sentinel outside captured inputs to the probe.

cases.name: network
cases.change: Request the harness loopback endpoint from an isolated action.

cases.name: symlink
cases.change: Create an escaping link in an isolated copy.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
